pr.title: Set smaller MAX_INLINE_NESTING to avoid python:3.13-alpine worker thread crash

problem_statement: Set smaller MAX_INLINE_NESTING to avoid python:3.13-alpine worker thread crash
gold_patch:
diff --git a/src/tomli/_parser.py b/src/tomli/_parser.py
index 2e4644f..f13f670 100644
--- a/src/tomli/_parser.py
+++ b/src/tomli/_parser.py
@@ -35,10 +35,12 @@ if TYPE_CHECKING:
 # mypyc docs this will be fixed in the future:
 # https://mypyc.readthedocs.io/en/latest/differences_from_python.html#stack-overflows
 # Before mypyc's fix is in, recursion needs to be limited by this library.
-# Choosing `sys.getrecursionlimit()` as maximum inline table/array nesting
-# level, as it allows more nesting than pure Python, but still seems a far
-# lower number than where mypyc binaries crash.
-MAX_INLINE_NESTING: Final = sys.getrecursionlimit()
+# Choosing 400 as maximum inline table/array nesting level, as it's 4x the
+# spec recommended minimum (https://github.com/toml-lang/toml/pull/1087)
+# (unreleased at the time of writing) and less than half of what causes an
+# unrecoverable crash in a worker (not main) thread on a python:3.13-alpine
+# image.
+MAX_INLINE_NESTING: Final = 400
 
 # Pathologically excessive number of parts in a key runs into quadratic
 # behavior (e.g. in Flags.is_).

pr.title: fix(yaml): use a non-zero indent when stringifying flat documents
pr.body:
### Problem

When `parseYAML` reads a document with no indented lines, such as `a: 1`, the detected indent is `""`. `stringifyYAML` passes its length, `0`, to `js-yaml`'s `dump`. Any nested value added to that object is then written at column 0, which changes the data when read back:

```js
const config = parseYAML("a: 1\n");
config.b = { c: [1, 2] };
stringifyYAML(config); // "a: 1\nb:\nc:\n- 1\n- 2\n"
parseYAML(stringifyYAML(config)); // { a: 1, b: null, c: [1, 2] }
```

### Change

`stringifyYAML` falls back to an indent of `2` when the detected indent is `0`. This is the same default `getFormat` uses for values that were not parsed. Detected non-zero indents and an explicit `indent` option behave as before.

### Tests

A new `yaml` test parses a flat document, adds a nested object and array, and checks both the output and that it parses back to the same data.

- Without the `src/yaml.ts` change: 1 failed, 28 passed, 1 skipped.
- With the change: 29 passed, 1 skipped. `pnpm test` (oxlint, oxfmt, tsc, vitest) and `pnpm build` pass.

Fixes #102
